steps.title: 1 · 質子化 BO5
steps.explanation: BO5 的一對孤對電子與 Hcat 成鍵；Osol–Hcat 的鍵電子回到 Osol。正電荷由 Osol 轉到 BO5。

steps.title: 2 · 形成羰基並開 B 環
steps.explanation: BO1 的孤對電子增加 BC1–BO1 鍵級；BC1–BO5 的鍵電子回到 BO5。兩支箭頭合併核對，不額外插入未建立的共振／碳正離子步驟。

steps.title: 3 · 去質子化並再生酸物種
steps.explanation: Osol（水）的孤對電子接走 BHO1；BO1–BHO1 的鍵電子回到 BO1，得到中性羰基與 H₃O⁺。酸物種再生，但其中質子身分已交換。

limits: Three finite textbook-inferred Lewis ledgers and computed representative states only, not lactose-specific experimental microsteps or complete free arrow grading. Acid may also hydrolyse the glycosidic bridge; selecting this route is not a selective acid condition. The omitted bulk solvent/counterions are not a model of a whole electroneutral acid solution.
protonIdentityScope: Final sugar BO5-Hcat and acid Osol-BHO1 exchange the original proton identities. The neutral P3b endpoint instead uses BO5-BHO1 as a formal endpoint map; heavy sugar connectivity and neutral species agree, but proton IDs must not be equated.
